prompt:
Use-case: ui-mockup. Create one high-fidelity desktop UI design concept, a flat screenshot of DeepSeek Harness with the dsh-memory-wiki plugin, landscape 16:10. Reference image role: existing DSH screenshot from this conversation, used only for the native host chrome, restrained dark blue-gray palette and sans-serif type character. Replace the plugin's current crowded three-column layout entirely. Do not copy workspace titles, account data, metadata IDs, current technical copy, or current contents from the reference.
Composition: an understated left DSH host navigation rail about 14% of width, with text "DeepSeek Harness", items "新会话", "工作区", "记忆 Wiki", selected "记忆 Wiki". Main plugin fills the rest. Short 64px top toolbar: title "记忆 Wiki", small subtitle "知识图谱", an elegant compact search field "搜索知识、概念与关联", quiet action "上下文". No permanent list sidebar in the plugin.
The entire main body is a beautiful readable knowledge relationship map, with generous breathing space, thin restrained curved blue-gray edges and tiny solid point nodes with legible Chinese labels. 24-35 nodes in organically spaced loose clusters, no rectangular cards for every node, no glowing galaxy, no neon, no gradient. Labels: "Agent 工程", "工具调用", "工具熔断", "重试策略", "幂等与写入恢复", "工具缓存", "上下文管理", "记忆检索", "证据快照", "SSE", "流式响应", "执行轨迹", "提示词". Color selection and connected edges with pale blue #8bc7f4, unrelated nodes muted. Add only subtle group text labels in the background, not giant outlined boxes. Show selected "工具熔断" in the left-middle unobscured part of the graph.
The key structural choice: NO right inspector and NO floating card. After a graph node is selected, a full-width reading desk rises from the bottom and takes the lower 34% of the main plugin area. Graph remains across the entire width in the upper 66%, refitted so its selected node is unobscured. Bottom desk is an opaque dark surface #212d39 separated by one subtle horizontal divider with a small resize handle. Bottom reading desk has an expansive main article column on left (about 68% desk width), and a small related-knowledge links column on right (32%). There is no modal scrim. This is an unmistakable upper graph / lower horizontal reader desktop arrangement. Panel content: small category "概念", title "工具熔断", a close icon, 3-4 short readable paragraph lines explaining tool failures, then heading "关联知识" with links "重试策略", "幂等与写入恢复", "工具缓存". At the upper right of the bottom reading desk one quiet secondary action "加入下一轮依据", not a dominant CTA. Compact plain footnote "浏览不会改变当前会话". No technical hashes, no revision strings, no candidate scoring, no debug prose.
Bottom-left canvas tiny legend "页面 · Wiki 链接" and compact fit/zoom toolbar. Bottom-right quiet status "自动检索已开启", not a dashboard or CTA. Small label in the app chrome "设计预览 · 示例内容". Native macOS-like crisp system sans, type remains readable, precise spacings. Full professional operable tool, restrained craft comparable to polished knowledge tools. Screen should clearly convey graph-first browsing with a wide bottom reading desk that opens only after clicking a node; no landing page, hero, illustration, real-world device, or decorative poster.
